title: Models
name: Name
transformersDeviceHint: This CUDA build supports explicit CPU execution. CUDA requires an available NVIDIA GPU; it never switches to CPU automatically.
visionDirectoryHint: Select a local WD14 directory containing model.onnx and selected_tags.csv. Supports static PNG, JPEG and WebP images.

siglip.directoryHint: Select a local SigLIP2 directory. Its configuration supplies model information automatically.
siglip.unloadOther: Unload the other tower when called
siglip.unloadOtherHint: On: calling one tower releases the other first. Off: both towers may remain loaded; requests still run one at a time. Unload and release policies apply to both towers.
siglip.deviceHint: CUDA uses FP16; CPU uses FP32. Vectors use the model's native dimensions, float32 and L2 normalization.
siglip.informationHint: Read from the selected directory. Missing values are determined during loading.
siglip.inspectionFailed: Model information is unavailable. You can still save this profile.
siglip.fixresHint: This fixed-resolution structure is shared by SigLIP and SigLIP2; it does not identify the training generation.

diagnostics.invalid_field: A declared field could not be interpreted.

cacheCleanConsequence: Future installations may need to download dependencies again. Installed environments are retained.

storage.title: Runtime storage
storage.incomplete: Some storage statistics are incomplete. Unavailable values are marked Unknown.
storage.estimateHint: Exclusive logical file size. Actual disk recovery depends on filesystem allocation, compression and copy-on-write sharing.

audioDeviceHint: Select CPU or NVIDIA CUDA. CUDA must be available when selected.
ttsSeedHint: Leave seed blank for unfixed randomness; 0 is a valid fixed seed. Speech requests can override it; omitted or null values inherit this setting. A fixed seed controls randomness but does not guarantee identical audio.
chatterboxReferenceHint: English speech requires a temporary voice ID or reference audio through the speech API. Temporary voices expire after 30 minutes; admitted requests extend their remaining lifetime to at least 15 minutes.
qwenReferenceHint: Multilingual Base cloning uses a temporary voice ID or reference audio through the speech API. Include the reference transcript for full conditioning, or omit it for audio-only cloning. Language defaults to automatic. The token limit can stop speech before the text ends. Disabling main-token sampling does not guarantee identical audio.
runtimeReuseHint: App updates reuse the installed runtime when dependencies are unchanged. Manual repair rebuilds the runtime.
providerSummary: Connections to online OpenAI-compatible services. Select a provider when configuring a model.
providerModelHint: Enter the provider model ID, or choose a discovered model. Discovery is optional.
discoveryUnavailable: Model discovery is unavailable. You can still enter a model ID and save.

textEmbedding.informationHint: Processing settings come from the selected model directory.
textEmbedding.directoryHint: Select a Sentence Transformers package under data/models/embeddings.
textEmbedding.inspectionFailed: Directory information could not be read.
textEmbedding.draftHint: You can save this profile. Resolve the listed issues before loading.
textEmbedding.deviceHint: CUDA uses the model's checkpoint precision; CPU uses float32. CUDA requires an available NVIDIA GPU.

asr.informationHint: Architecture and processing settings come from the model directory. The native window is an internal processing unit, not a recording length limit.

asr.temperatureHint: Zero uses deterministic decoding; a positive value enables sampling.
asr.promptHint: Optional context or vocabulary for the recording. Leave empty to clear the saved prompt.
asr.timestampsHint: JSON and text omit timestamps; detailed JSON returns segment timestamps. Every format transcribes the complete recording.

dlssComponentHint: Bundled with the application; installs offline and shares the base Python environment. Installation creates a default profile and processors/dlss5-nr directory. Supply nvngx_dlssnr.dll manually. Component uninstall preserves resources and profiles.

processor.directoryHint: The directory must contain your manually supplied nvngx_dlssnr.dll. Install the DLSS NR component in Local Runtime first.
processor.defaultsHint: Processes one image, preserving oriented dimensions and alpha. API requests can override these defaults. Maximum 8,388,608 pixels and 16,384 per axis.
